title: REQUIEM
author: Cooper T.
desc:
Pros:
Biggest bench of your life
Works like a charm after the egolifting program!
No legs ❤️
So strong 
Get your anime dream physique!

Cons:
MADE BY ME ✌️😭🕊️
Shoulders might click weirdly 
Shirts won’t fit no mo

ss.note: Superset: pin press first, then the bench single. 3-second maximal push into the pins.

ex.note: Seated Y-raise.
Stop 2 reps shy of failure (2 RIR) on each set.
10-second isometric hold at 100% of bench max.
No prescribed load - feel it out. Supramaximal, judged by feel rather than a set percentage.

ss.note: Superset: pin press first, then the bench single. 5-second maximal push into the pins.

ex.note: Seated Y-raise.
Stop 2 reps shy of failure (2 RIR) on each set.
Isometric hold at 105% of bench max for 6 seconds.
No prescribed load - feel it out. Supramaximal, judged by feel rather than a set percentage.
